responsibilities_pt.item: Implementei monitoramento com Grafana, Prometheus, Loki e Alertmanager, integrando alertas ao Microsoft Teams.
Desenvolvi automações Terraform, Helm charts, Dockerfiles e pipelines Bamboo / Shell para aplicações Node.js.
Administrei HashiCorp Vault, Consul, Redis e RabbitMQ e implementei controles de menor privilégio na AWS.

responsibilities_en.item: Implemented monitoring with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki and Alertmanager, routing alerts to Microsoft Teams.
Built Terraform automation, Helm charts, Dockerfiles and Bamboo / Shell pipelines for Node.js applications.
Administered HashiCorp Vault, Consul, Redis and RabbitMQ and implemented least-privilege controls on AWS.
